## Measurements and reference values

- [statement] In the NT-0796 phase 1b study, 10 subjects with PD received 150 mg open-label NT-0796 every 12 h for 28 days. (medium confidence) — https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/40792655/ · keywords: Neuroinflammation: NLRP3 and microglia targets · also: https://www.alzforum.org/news/conference-coverage/nlrp3-inhibitor-passes-muster-early-parkinsons-trial

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] A news report on a conference presentation says that in Roche's selnoflast study in Parkinson's disease, the inflammasome-driven cytokine response in lipopolysaccharide-treated blood samples was down by about 90 percent from study start and IL-18 in cerebrospinal fluid had fallen by about 30 percent on day 28, with no differences in the placebo group. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-03-27) — https://www.alzforum.org/news/conference-coverage/nlrp3-inhibitor-passes-muster-early-parkinsons-trial · keywords: Neuroinflammation: NLRP3 and microglia targets
- [statement] Dapansutrile, described as having a highly specific effect on the NLRP3 inflammasome, is in a Phase 2 trial in Parkinson's disease registered as NCT07157735 with status RECRUITING and an estimated 36 participants. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-27) — https://clinicaltrials.gov/api/v2/studies/NCT07157735 · keywords: Neuroinflammation: NLRP3 and microglia targets · also: https://cureparkinsons.org.uk/2026/02/results-from-the-phase-2-aza-pd-trial-are-now-published/

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] A news report on a conference presentation says selnoflast motor outcomes were exploratory: MDS-UPDRS Part III improved by two to three points in the selnoflast group versus worsening by a point or less on placebo, and average differences were small and not statistically significant. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-03-27) — https://www.alzforum.org/news/conference-coverage/nlrp3-inhibitor-passes-muster-early-parkinsons-trial · keywords: Neuroinflammation: NLRP3 and microglia targets
- [statement] A review reports that in sargramostim, a recombinant GMCSF, undergoing extended phase 1 testing, initial results with 8 weeks of treatment in 20 patients with PD showed increased numbers and suppressive function of peripheral T regulatory cells and a modest reduction in UPDRS part III scores versus the placebo arm. (low confidence) — https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11492043/ · keywords: Neuroinflammation: NLRP3 and microglia targets

## Facts and statements

- [statement] Reviews report that α-synuclein can drive NLRP3 inflammasome activation in microglia, and that inflammasome activation releases pro-inflammatory cytokines. (medium confidence) — https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11492043/ · keywords: Neuroinflammation: NLRP3 and microglia targets · also: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12916702/
- [statement] The authors report that NT-0796 drove reductions in systemic inflammatory markers including high-sensitivity C-reactive protein, fibrinogen and IL-18, and reductions in neuroinflammation within the CNS of subjects with PD. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-03-27) — https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/40792655/ · keywords: Neuroinflammation: NLRP3 and microglia targets · also: https://www.alzforum.org/news/conference-coverage/nlrp3-inhibitor-passes-muster-early-parkinsons-trial
- [statement] The NT-0796 phase 1b study was designed to assess safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetics and anti-inflammatory effects, and a news report on the work states that motor outcomes were not assessed. (medium confidence) — https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/40792655/ · keywords: Neuroinflammation: NLRP3 and microglia targets · also: https://www.alzforum.org/news/conference-coverage/nlrp3-inhibitor-passes-muster-early-parkinsons-trial
- [statement] The VENT-02 Parkinson's study registered as NCT06822517 lists incidence of treatment-emergent adverse events (TEAEs) as its primary outcome, and its congress abstract states the primary endpoint is safety. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-27) — https://clinicaltrials.gov/api/v2/studies/NCT06822517 · keywords: Neuroinflammation: NLRP3 and microglia targets · also: https://www.mdsabstracts.org/abstract/a-randomized-double-blind-placebo-controlled-phase-2-study-of-the-nlrp3-inhibitor-vent-02-in-patients-with-mild-to-moderate-parkinsons-disease/
- [statement] Sources differ on the VENT-02 Parkinson's study: the congress abstract and sponsor page describe a Phase 2 program with 30 patients, while registry record NCT06822517 titles it Phase 1b and lists status TERMINATED with 29 enrolled. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-27) — https://www.mdsabstracts.org/abstract/a-randomized-double-blind-placebo-controlled-phase-2-study-of-the-nlrp3-inhibitor-vent-02-in-patients-with-mild-to-moderate-parkinsons-disease/ · keywords: Neuroinflammation: NLRP3 and microglia targets · also: https://www.ventustx.com/pipeline/nlrp3/, https://clinicaltrials.gov/api/v2/studies/NCT06822517
- [statement] Roche's NCT05924243 study of RO7486967 in early idiopathic PD is registered as a Phase 1b, adaptive, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled study with registry status COMPLETED. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-27) — https://clinicaltrials.gov/api/v2/studies/NCT05924243 · keywords: Neuroinflammation: NLRP3 and microglia targets · also: https://www.isrctn.com/ISRCTN85338453
- [statement] In the AZA-PD randomised, placebo-controlled phase 2 trial (66 randomly assigned: azathioprine n=32, placebo n=34), the primary outcome, change in MDS-UPDRS gait-axial score in the off-state at 12 months, was not met. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-27) — https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41389828/ · keywords: Neuroinflammation: NLRP3 and microglia targets · also: https://cureparkinsons.org.uk/2026/02/results-from-the-phase-2-aza-pd-trial-are-now-published/
- [statement] Exploratory analyses in the azathioprine trial suggested effects on immune biomarkers and motor symptoms, but a charity summary calls it a small proof-of-concept trial whose findings need validation in larger trials. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-27) — https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41389828/ · keywords: Neuroinflammation: NLRP3 and microglia targets · also: https://cureparkinsons.org.uk/2026/02/results-from-the-phase-2-aza-pd-trial-are-now-published/
- [statement] Reviews report that minocycline, which reduces microglial activation and shows therapeutic effects in PD animal models, was not progressed to phase 3 and failed to show significant therapeutic efficacy in a Phase II clinical trial. (medium confidence) — https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11492043/ · keywords: Neuroinflammation: NLRP3 and microglia targets · also: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12916702/
- [statement] A review and a Michael J. Fox Foundation grant summary both frame selecting trial participants by inflammatory phenotype or neuroinflammation-related PD subtype as a route to better trial success. (medium confidence) — https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11492043/ · keywords: Neuroinflammation: NLRP3 and microglia targets · also: https://www.michaeljfox.org/grant/assessing-inhibition-nlrp3-reduce-brain-inflammation-parkinsons-disease
- [statement] A review states that microglia play dual roles in PD, phagocytosing and clearing α-syn aggregates while becoming dysfunctional due to aggregate overload, which drives their transition to a pro-inflammatory phenotype. (low confidence) — https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12916702/ · keywords: Neuroinflammation: NLRP3 and microglia targets

## Research summary — Neuroinflammation: NLRP3 and microglia targets

NLRP3 inflammasome activation in microglia, which α-synuclein can drive, is a neuroinflammation target in PD. Early NLRP3 inhibitor studies of NT-0796 and selnoflast were short safety and biomarker studies, not efficacy trials. The VENT-02 registry record is TERMINATED. Minocycline and azathioprine did not meet efficacy goals, and a review says selecting participants by inflammatory phenotype could potentially enhance success.
